summary: Cosan S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its voluntary delisting of American Depositary Shares (ADSs) from the NYSE, following material facts disclosed on August 14 and August 18, 2026. The last trading day on the NYSE is September 18, 2026. After delisting, Cosan will maintain a Level I ADR program, allowing ADSs to continue trading on the OTC market in the US. The filing includes no financial terms or board recommendation. The CFO signed the notice. Watch for the successful delisting completion and continued OTC liquidity.
